notes: Reference use-case 3 of 3 — 'process + reporting'. The two framework patterns every F&O project implements repeatedly: a SysOperation batch job (contract / service / controller / menu item) and an RDP-based SSRS report (TempDB table / contract / DP / AxReport with a design / output menu item). The report design is the hardest artifact to write by hand — that is where the with/without MCP gap should be widest. Grounding the MCP server should supply: CustTransOpen's fields, the SysOperation and SRS base classes and attributes, the AxReport dataset + design shape.
